olga: quick handoff from the night shift. summary: reranker service (us-west) started returning 429s intermittently from 23:459C00:15 UTC. Root cause appears to be sudden KV cache churn + autoscaler bounce on the rerank pool that pushed many inflight requests into short retry loops. We applied an emergency floor to the pool (min_capacity +3) and a temporary route for new requests -> us-east for 30m. Customer impact: some user-facing ranking requests got 429s (retryable) and a handful of background batch jobs retried and delayed ~10-25m. No request data lost. Ticket: INC-1302.

ben: saw the pager at 23:47, joined the bridge. Logs show rapid leader churn on rerank-leader-03 causing proxy backpressure. grep snippet below:
```
23:46:12 rerank-leader-03 kernel: malloc: out of memory: process reranker(4421) killed
23:46:13 rerank-proxy: queue_delay p50 120ms -> 800ms
23:47:01 autoscaler[rerank]: scale_up triggered current=4 requested=7
```

ashwin: adding context from runtime team: we've seen similar fragmentation when pinned q4_quant kernels load concurrently with long sequences. Night workload had a spike in seq_len>1024 which likely triggered larger KV allocations. Mitigations we used: 1) bumped pool floor, 2) disabled aggressive launch packing, 3) short-circuit routing to another region. We've paused the autoscaler's downscale for 40m to avoid thrash. Runbook used: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/reranker-autoscale

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-1302 created at 23:48 UTC. Severity: Sev2. Assigned: ben (primary), olga (secondary). Bridge: https://pd.redwood/INC-1302

olga: status at handoff: 429 rate has dropped from 3.8% peak to 0.12% over last 20m. p95 latency for rerank (us-west) is 1.1s (baseline: 0.45s). No new OOMs on leader hosts for last 25m. Temporary routing remains until 00:30 UTC. Autoscaler shows stable active=7 after the floor bump.

kevin: I'm taking the follow-up owner for next 12h—will validate repro and coordinate the postmortem. Action items I tracked: capture heap / jemalloc stats from rerank-leader-03, enable persistent jemalloc stats on the pool, and create a staging replay with >10% long-seq samples.

ben: immediate items I left in the ticket: 1) dump /var/dumps on rerank-leader-03 and upload to stash; 2) enable jemalloc (if not already) and collect stats; 3) add guardrails to the autoscaler cooldown to prevent repeated scale down/up within 10m. Snippet I used to fetch dump:
```
ssh ops@rerank-leader-03 'sudo tar -czf /tmp/rerank-dumps-$(date +%s).tgz /var/dumps && scp /tmp/*.tgz oncall@stash:/tmp/'
```

olga: coverage note: APAC secondary coverage was limited last night (only one oncall in region after midnight), which slowed the escalation handover by ~4 minutes. We'll flag this for rota adjustments next week.

ashwin: technical note: we changed packing flags in runtime config to avoid loading q4_quant kernels concurrently. Current flag: runtime.flags.packing=false (manual override). We'll measure CPU/memory overhead in staging before making permanent change. Config link: //ops/configs/runtime/packing

olga: post-incident tasks assigned in INC-1302 checklist: \n- [x] emergency floor + routing applied\n- [x] 30m stable monitoring confirmed\n- [ ] ben: upload heap & jemalloc stats (in progress)\n- [ ] kevin: reproduce on staging with long-seq replay (todo)\n- [ ] ashwin: propose autoscaler cooldown guard (todo)\n- [ ] olga: draft CS notify for affected batch tenants (blocked on heap confirmation)\n
ben: ETA for heap upload and initial analysis ~4-6h. If we reproduce fragmentation I'll open a runtime PR to expose jemalloc tuning flags and request expedited review. If there's regression I'll page primary mobile.

kevin: I'll be available for the morning window and will take the lead on postmortem write-up. Please add any logs/links to INC-1302. Dashboards to watch: \n- Reranker 429 rate (us-west): https://metrics.redwood/rerank/429-rate?region=us-west\n- Rerank queue latency: https://metrics.redwood/rerank/queue-latency\n- Autoscaler events: https://metrics.redwood/autoscaler/events?pool=rerank

incident-bot: Manual routing change recorded by ben at 23:51 UTC.

olga: handing off now to ben (primary) + kevin (secondary). If anything regresses ping mobile and update INC-1302. Thanks for quick triage everyone :thumbsup:

ben: taking over watch for next 6 hours. I'll keep alerts unmuted and update ticket on any significant changes.
